propositions: Log assertions using caplog can pass vacuously when zero records are captured, yielding green output despite zero coverage, because negative assertions (assert not [...]) are trivially true against empty lists

Logger propagation disabled in rebar.review_bot.config.configure_logging at module import time prevents any rebar.* log records from reaching pytest's caplog handler, silently breaking all downstream caplog assertions on that logger in the same process

Logger levels raised globally by rebar._logging.install_stderr_handler suppress INFO-level records at the originating logger, making them unreachable to caplog.at_level(INFO) assertions when called without logger parameter after CLI entrypoints

An unreachable log assertion can appear green in one test order but fail in another due to nondeterministic test distribution, making coverage non-reproducible and detectable only through instrumentation

Five negative caplog assertions in the suite can silently verify nothing while reporting success, detected only because one victim uses next(...) which raises StopIteration instead of silently succeeding on empty iterators
